subject.title: Rename i18n locale codes from region-based (zh-CN/zh-TW) to script-based (zh-Hans/zh-Hant)

question: Should OpenClaw change the canonical Chinese locale IDs from `zh-CN`/`zh-TW` to `zh-Hans`/`zh-Hant` across Control UI, CLI wizard, and docs publish metadata?
rationale: The change is semantically reasonable but crosses public locale contracts, persisted browser state, generated artifacts, workflow matrices, and docs publishing behavior, so automation cannot choose the product contract safely.

options.title: Approve coordinated script-ID migration
options.body: Move runtime, wizard, docs publish metadata, generated i18n assets, workflows, tests, and saved-preference migration together in one reviewed change.

options.title: Keep current region IDs
options.body: Treat `zh-CN` and `zh-TW` as the stable OpenClaw user-facing contract and continue terminology improvements under those IDs.

options.title: Defer to broader i18n planning
options.body: Leave this open as a product backlog item until maintainers settle the long-term localization contract.

recommendation.title: Approve coordinated script-ID migration
recommendation.body: Move runtime, wizard, docs publish metadata, generated i18n assets, workflows, tests, and saved-preference migration together in one reviewed change.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is tied to the current blamed locale contract snapshot plus wizard/docs i18n history, making him the best current routing owner for the product-contract decision.
